svg.text: Magic Card icon library and preset look: three directions
Stock MDI geometry only, one colour (entity or state colour).
Motion: small, single-axis, 0.15 to 0.3 of an icon unit; no shapes or accents.
Lightest bytes and CPU. Animals, fans and tools mostly move as one piece.
MDI silhouettes cut into real joints; new drawings follow the MDI grid.
One colour like MDI; theme colour comes from presets and the entity.
Motion with weight: anticipation, overshoot, settle. Loops 1.2 to 4 s.
Rigs from B plus an accent layer (flame core, bulbs, beams) in a glow colour.
Soft glow filter on accents; seasonal entries lean festive.
Richest look; costs a filter per icon on tablets and fights entity colours.
Theme pairs (B and C). Left: icon colour, at least 3:1 on #1c1c1c and #ffffff. Right: glow colour, decorative only (particles, glows, accents).
Faded copies show one key pose of the motion. Icons: MDI by Pictogrammers (Apache-2.0) and Magic Card rigs cut from them (assets/brand/icon-library).
